--- rough-ride hunt (copy this block unchanged) ---
rough-ride hunt | 5m00s | run 20261112-180438-hunt-2bb9 | 5 confirmed, 0 dropped on re-run
target: http://localhost:3790

Findings (each reproduced twice from scratch)
1. HIGH   Waterings page crashes on a malformed list response; navigation silently stays on the previous page
   where: /waterings (GET /api/waterings)
   expected: Waterings page opens and shows an error that the waterings could not be loaded
   saw: {"url":"/waterings","headings":["Beds","Add a bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner"],"alerts":[],"pageErrors":["waterings.value?.reduce is not a function"]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-180438-hunt-2bb9/probes/waterings-malformed.mjs (expectation "malformed-list-shows-error-not-crash")
2. MEDIUM Dashboard renders a malformed waterings response as rows of 'Never' with blank bed and amount
   where: / (Recent waterings, GET /api/waterings?limit=5)
   expected: An error saying recent waterings could not be loaded
   saw: {"section":["Recent waterings","All waterings","The five most recent waterings","WHEN\tBED\tAMOUNT","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–","Never\t\t–"],"alerts":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-180438-hunt-2bb9/probes/dashboard-malformed.mjs (expectation "malformed-recent-waterings-shows-error")
3. MEDIUM Dashboard shows 'No waterings yet' when the waterings response is not a list
   where: / (Recent waterings)
   expected: A visible load error, because waterings exist
   saw: {"section":["Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one.","Go to beds","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"],"alerts":[]}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-180438-hunt-2bb9/probes/dashboard-empty-object.mjs (expectation "bad-response-not-shown-as-no-waterings")
4. MEDIUM Past-watering form accepts amounts under 0.005 L, then shows and lists them as '0 L'
   where: /beds Record past watering form, POST /api/waterings
   expected: Amount below the field's 0.1 L minimum is refused, or at least shown as a non-zero amount
   saw: {"created":1,"alerts":["Recorded 0 L on 8 Nov 2026."],"newest":{"id":6,"bed_id":2,"bed_name":"Shade corner","watered_on":"2026-11-08","watered_at":null,"litres":0.004}}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-180438-hunt-2bb9/probes/past-form-inputs.mjs (expectation "tiny-litres-refused-or-shown-nonzero")
5. MEDIUM No way to retry after the waterings list fails to load, short of reloading
   where: /waterings
   expected: A Try again control (or similar) next to the load error
   saw: {"btns":0}
   repro: .rough-ride/runs/20261112-180438-hunt-2bb9/probes/waterings-page.mjs (expectation "retry-available-after-error")
--- end of rough-ride hunt ---
